name: Operator: the writer
description: The writer: body and a separately modeled head grafted at the collar, her pack skinned to the Spine bone.

made_with.settings: multi-image, 4K texture; body (front, side, back; hair pinned up), head (four views, full curls) and pack (three views) separately, then tools/prep_operator.py (graft, neck cleanup in clothes mode, head at 4 mm voxels with the glasses kept apart, remesh, bake, --rig); Meshy auto-rig; tools/add_fingers.py

notes: 70,000 faces before finger loops: body 25,000, head 30,000 (curls rebuilt at 4 mm voxels so they hold together), glasses 2,450 at full detail, pack 12,000; two textures. Mixamo-named finger bones with a relaxed curl as the rest pose. The pack is part of the skinned mesh, weighted fully to Spine. In the battle as Bravo since 2026-10-17.
